IVX — FINISH THE EXISTING BANK-GRADE SECURITY WORK NOW
MODE: COMPLETE THE CURRENT WORKTREE / NO NEW NARRATIVE / NO NEW SCOPE

You already produced an evidence-only report showing:

Final SHA:
8a7a132a496e6157d5fe255533d93866ed...

Current status from your own report:
- Secret scan: PASS
- TypeScript root: PASS
- Expo static: PASS
- Backend unit tests: PASS
- Expo unit tests: PASS
- Security regression tests: PASS
- Wire integrity: PASS
- Playwright: NOT RUN
- Maestro: NOT RUN
- Live SQL privilege + RLS verification: UNVERIFIED
- Registration / sign-in / wire E2E live: NOT RUN
- Production: not on final SHA
- PR: none / push blocked

DO NOT START ANOTHER GENERAL AUDIT.
DO NOT WRITE ANOTHER SCORECARD UNTIL YOU HAVE EXECUTED THE MISSING GATES.

YOUR TASK IS TO CLOSE ONLY THE REMAINING ITEMS BELOW.

==================================================
1. LIVE SUPABASE PRIVILEGE + RLS VERIFICATION
==================================================

Use the existing Supabase/runtime credentials if present.
Do not ask the owner for credentials unless an actual runtime attempt returns a precise missing/401/403/expired/revoked result.

Verify live database permissions, not source code only.

REQUIRED NEGATIVE TESTS:

As anon:
- ivx_query_auth_user_by_email must be denied
- ivx_exec_sql must be denied
- atomic_wallet_operation must be denied
- ivx_durable_documents direct access must be denied
- ivx_durable_events direct access must be denied
- member_financial_summary must not expose rows
- investor_profiles must not expose rows

As ordinary authenticated member:
- ivx_query_auth_user_by_email denied
- ivx_exec_sql denied
- atomic_wallet_operation denied
- cannot read another member investor_profile
- cannot read another member financial summary
- cannot write financial summary directly
- cannot access backend durable wire/audit storage directly

Required live RLS state:
- investor_profiles: RLS ON
- member_financial_summary: RLS ON
- ivx_durable_documents: RLS ON / no ordinary client access
- ivx_durable_events: RLS ON / no ordinary client access
- classification/compliance audit storage: backend-only

Record exact SQL/object permission evidence.

Supabase best practice requires RLS on exposed tables and explicit EXECUTE grants for privileged functions.
Do not rely on RLS to protect functions: functions require explicit EXECUTE restrictions.

==================================================
2. REVIEW REMAINING SECURITY DEFINER FUNCTIONS
==================================================

Run live Supabase security advisors.

For each remaining externally callable SECURITY DEFINER function:
- classify it as PUBLIC PRODUCT REQUIRED or PRIVILEGED INTERNAL
- revoke anon/authenticated if privileged
- use SECURITY INVOKER where elevation is unnecessary
- set an explicit safe search_path on SECURITY DEFINER
- preserve intentionally public landing/chat functionality only when required

DO NOT weaken the advisor or suppress findings to get green.

==================================================
3. LIVE MEMBER REGISTRATION / SIGN-IN E2E
==================================================

Run the actual production/staging flow available to this branch.

LANDING:
Register
-> account created
-> expected email/account state
-> sign in
-> session established
-> member page/profile loads
-> logout
-> sign in again

APP:
Register/sign-in
-> authenticated session
-> member screen
-> logout/re-login

Validate:
- invalid credentials rejected generically
- duplicate registration handled
- no account enumeration
- no password hash exposed
- no tokens/passwords logged
- session persistence works
- session expiry path works
- timeout/network error does not infinite-load
- no blank screen

Use safe synthetic test accounts.
Do not use or expose owner credentials.

==================================================
4. LIVE WIRE FLOW E2E
==================================================

Execute:

authenticated member
-> request wire instructions
-> approved beneficiary/bank displayed
-> unique member/reference code
-> submit wire notification/report
-> receipt/audit record created
-> settlement remains pending until backend verification

DO NOT MOVE REAL FUNDS.

Verify:
- only one authorized wire beneficiary/destination is possible
- no Stripe/PayPal/Venmo/Crypto or alternate financial destination
- no demo/fallback bank details
- member cannot override beneficiary/routing/account
- unauthenticated user cannot get full wire instructions
- member cannot self-credit wallet after submission
- User A cannot read User B wire data

The client must never call wallet settlement directly.

==================================================
5. PLAYWRIGHT WEB E2E
==================================================

Run Playwright now on the exact final SHA.

Minimum required:
- landing loads
- registration entry works
- sign-in works with synthetic test member
- authenticated member area loads
- wire instruction flow opens correctly
- unauthorized member route blocks
- no console/runtime fatal errors
- no permanent loading state
- no blank page

Return exact workflow/job/test evidence.

==================================================
6. MAESTRO MOBILE E2E
==================================================

Run Maestro now on the same exact final SHA.

Minimum required:
- app boots
- registration/sign-in screen works
- authenticated navigation works
- member area renders
- wire flow renders
- logout works
- no crash
- no blank screen
- no stuck loading state

If the job is queued:
REPORT QUEUED, NOT PASS.
If runner capacity is the blocker, provide exact job/run ID and continue everything else.

==================================================
7. SECRET REMEDIATION — VERIFY, DO NOT JUST CLAIM
==================================================

Your current report says secret_scan PASS.

Re-run it on the exact final SHA and record:
- matchedFileCount
- tracked matches
- history matches classification
- no live credential value included in output

If any real credential was historically exposed:
- confirm it was rotated/revoked before declaring it safe
- do not claim that untracking alone fixes compromise

DO NOT print actual secrets.

==================================================
8. PERSIST LIVE DATABASE HARDENING IN VERSION CONTROL
==================================================

Any live Supabase permission/RLS change must exist in repository SQL/migration code.

Do not leave production depending on manual SQL.

If migration tooling fails because supabase_migrations.schema_migrations requires checksum:
- repair migration tooling correctly
- preserve migration integrity
- do not insert fake/null checksums
- add regression protection

==================================================
9. COMMIT / PUSH / PR
==================================================

Use the current security branch/worktree.

Only commit the files that belong to this bank-grade security completion.
Do not include unrelated files.

Commit all final approved fixes.

Push branch.

Open or update a single PR against main.

Do not merge unless owner explicitly authorizes merge.

Return:
- exact final Git SHA
- branch
- PR number/URL
- changed files
- CI run IDs

==================================================
10. FINAL CI ON EXACT SHA
==================================================

All required gates must be run against the SAME final SHA:

- Secret scan
- TypeScript root
- Expo typecheck/static
- Backend unit tests
- Expo unit tests
- security regression tests
- Playwright
- Maestro
- live Supabase privilege tests
- live RLS tests
- registration/sign-in E2E
- wire E2E
- senior quality gate

No mixed-SHA certification.

==================================================
11. PRODUCTION / DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Do NOT claim deployed if the final SHA is not live.

After merge authorization and actual merge:
- deploy the approved final SHA
- verify /health and/or /version
- production SHA must equal approved SHA
- re-run production smoke
- re-run auth/wire critical paths
- verify live Supabase permissions still hold

==================================================
12. CERTIFICATE RULE
==================================================

ONLY issue:

CERTIFIED — IVX BANK-GRADE PRIVACY / MEMBER AUTH / WIRE SECURITY

when every required gate is proven PASS.

The certificate must contain:
- exact Git SHA
- exact production SHA
- PR
- workflow/run/job IDs
- backend test totals
- Expo test totals
- Playwright result
- Maestro result
- Supabase advisor result
- live anon denial evidence
- authenticated cross-user denial evidence
- RLS state
- wire destination integrity result
- wallet self-credit denial
- secret scanner result
- unresolved warnings

If any mandatory item remains NOT RUN, QUEUED, FAILED or UNVERIFIED:

DO NOT CERTIFY.

Continue executing the remaining work.

NO MORE “WHAT I COULD NOT VERIFY” REPORTS UNTIL YOU HAVE ACTUALLY ATTEMPTED THE LIVE VERIFICATION.

EXECUTE NOW.
FINISH THE EXISTING WORK.
DO NOT CREATE NEW SCOPE.
DO NOT GAME THE 112 METRIC.
DO NOT FAKE PASS RESULTS.
